profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Motivated software engineer currently working as a Front End Engineer. I have a strong  background in software engineering due to my school, internship, and work experience. I specialize primarily in Web Development technologies such as Javascript, React, Typescript, Python, and Django.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description: Skills: HTML · JavaScript · CSS · Redux.js · React · TypeScript

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
Inxeption is the Industrial Commerce SuperApp. Its secure and scalable cloud-based digital commerce platform brings the ease of consumer e-commerce to B2B. Companies of any size in any industry can drive more sales, gain operational visibility, and realize cost savings. Inxeption Commerce Partners enjoy access to sell products on the Inxeption B2B marketplace and to develop new online commerce channels, as well as valuable applications that simplify and streamline logistics and other operations.

At Inxeption I was responsible for developing and maintaining Inxeption's various frontend React/JS codebases as well as participating in code reviews for all the engineers in my immediate front-end team. Towards the end of my time here, I became the owner of Inxpetion's suite of Logisitcs applications where business owners (Commerce Partners as we called them) could manage creating shipping quotes from customer orders, accepting quotes to create shipments, and viewing the tracking status of customer’s shipments.
positions.insights: Skills: SASS · HTML · JavaScript · CSS · Git · Redux.js · GraphQL · React · Bitbucket · Code Review · TypeScript

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
Banyan security is a security platform that enables employees and third parties to remotely access on-premise, hybrid, and multi-cloud applications and servers without the need to use VPNs through a ZeroTrust architecture.

I worked as a front end engineer responsible for maintaining and developing Banyan's Command Center which admins use to monitor their employee's devices and services as well as get high level insights on them.
positions.insights: Skills: SASS · HTML · JavaScript · CSS · Git · Redux.js · React · Code Review · TypeScript

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: -Design, develop, and maintain Corax's Python backend codebase.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Duties and Responsibilities:
-Maintain Corax's private and public REST API.
-Develop and maintain the API's test suite with Pytest.
-Provide bug fixes and minor features in Corax's frontend React application.
-Maintain the schema of the database and make changes whenever necessary.
-Collaborate with both the front-end team and management on a daily basis to plan, develop, and test new features for the application.
-Provide technical support and implement hotfixes for customers that are currently using the application.

Notable Accomplishments:
-Lead the API team in the migration of our private and public API’s from Ruby on Rails to Django.
-Developed Corax’s public API that is currently being consumed by customers.
-Developed Corax’s subscription model and payments service with Stripe for subscriptions and payments.
-Developed the entire test suite for both the private and public API, getting coverage to ~90%

positions.title: Software Validation Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Selected for 12 month internship for the USB Pre-Silicon Validation Team.

Duties and Responsibilities:
- Design, run, and fix bugs for a program written in Java used to facilitate the detection of errors in the USB architecture.
- Develop and modify the system's unit tests in JUnit
- Develop Perl scripts and tools to help optimize the validation environment, tools, capabilities, and methodologies of the USB team.
- Help implement a code review workflow into the team.

positions.description:

File insurance documents pertaining to clients.

projects.title: Perplex (Workout randomizer app)
projects.description:
Workout Randomizer app that generates random workouts based on chosen muscle groups and desired number of exercises.

Features:
-Ruby on Rails
-Single Page Design
-Javascript with Jquery library for workout generation
-HTML,CSS, and Bootstrap for front-end design
-Heroku for deployment.
-Wger REST API for exercise data

projects.title: PetFriendsForever (Animal adoption website)
projects.description:
-Term Project for Software Engineering (CS 648) Course
-Implement and utilize the LAMP stack to create a fully-functioning, animal adoption website.
-Implement MVC architecture for the website.
-Utilizes the Twitter Bootstrap and JQuery frameworks

-Role: Tech Lead
      -Supervised and maintained version control with Subversion
      -Tested and decided what frameworks and technologies would be utilized
      -Ensured that proper code styles and conventions were being utilized
      -Helped develop both the front-end and back-end of website
